# owner: platform
"""Plain text absence notices for parents."""

from typing import Iterable

from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.attendance import days_missed

def absence_notice(student: Student, marks: Iterable[Mark]) -> str:
    """Short notice naming the student, days missed and the dates in order."""
    marks = list(marks)
    if any(mark.student_id != student.student_id for mark in marks):
        raise ProjectError("marks belong to a different student")
    days = days_missed(marks)
    if not days:
        raise ProjectError("no absences to report")
    count = len(days)
    noun = "day" if count == 1 else "days"
    dates = ", ".join(day.isoformat() for day in days)
    return f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name} missed {count} {noun}: {dates}."
EOF
cat > tests/test_notices.py <<'EOF'
import unittest
from datetime import date

from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError

KID = Student("1", "Doe", "Sam", "A")


def mark(day, status="absent", student_id="1"):
    return Mark(student_id, date(2026, 9, day), status)


class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_dates_in_order(self):
        text = absence_notice(KID, [mark(5), mark(2), mark(3, "present")])
        self.assertEqual(text, "Sam Doe missed 2 days: 2026-09-02, 2026-09-05.")

    def test_other_student(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(KID, [mark(2), mark(3, student_id="2")])

    def test_no_absences(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            absence_notice(KID, [mark(2, "excused")])
EOF

EOF
